title: Elucidating the synergistic benefits of the ternary metal components in a cobalt–molybdenum hybrid sulfide–nickel nitride composite as supercapacitor electrodes
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00399G, Paper
Shalakha Saha, Chandra Shekhar Sharma, Nishar Hameed, Nisa Salim
Driven by synergistic metal interaction and hierarchical architecture, the ternary sulfide–nitride composite achieves a specific energy value of 58 Wh kg−1 at a specific power of 200 W kg−1, offering the potential for next-generation supercapacitors.
